levels.desc: Relaxed ride. Enemies are weaker and slower, and power-ups drop more often.
The intended game. A fair fight for new pilots and seasoned aces alike.
Tougher enemies, faster bullets and fewer pickups. For true Cosmic Aces.

note: Hard x1.5 / Easy x0.5 apply to FIRST-clear credits. enemy_hp and bullet_speed apply to enemies, mini-bosses and bosses.
